findings_resolved: The source archive is streamed through an explicit GzipFile while git archive stdout remains a pipe; the retained archive is bound to its exact 10771-file census, byte count, and SHA-256.

Source and build custody is role-aware: baseline and candidate source snapshots, candidate freeze and overlay, build receipts, binaries, depfiles, flags, quality receipts, reviews, and isolated quality-source preparation are linked by exact descriptors and receipt identities.

The transitive 0887 reducer, capture/verification helpers, quality runner, and isolated quality-source helper are included in the sealed helper set; sealed historical fixtures and the 0893 guard reference are descriptor-bound.

Candidate quality is pinned to the 506aa2eda baseline HEAD and to the isolated archive-plus-overlay source root; the private generated lock, support files, archive, overlays, and runner copy are checked against their bindings.

The child validator requires the fixed corpus, strict 0893 guard vectors, aligned sample indices, source freshness, static route/cold flags, role-specific binary identity, command/receipt equality, and ordered fresh-child schedule.

The fail-fast capture, complete-population requirement, paired reducer, allocator failed-call check, bootstrap protocol, and independent no-workload verifier reject incomplete or substituted child evidence.
limitations: CPU 12 affinity is recorded without an exclusive-host guarantee; warm-cache timing variation remains possible.
RSS and allocator counters are descriptive observations and carry no automatic adoption gate; runtime route and physical-cold claims remain excluded.
The 0887 reducer is reused through the sealed 0894 adapter and is hash-bound, but it is not an independently implemented reducer.

At review time the actual 0894 quality receipt, candidate/baseline plan, builds, corpus capture, reduction, and independent verification were still pending; this receipt approves only the protocol for measurement.
